findings.text: Local datetime, date and time values are parsed with a fixed-offset zone (localOffset), so their wall-clock fields are in that zone. The encoder then calls v.In(time.UTC).Format(format), which shifts the wall clock by the offset. With a +02:00 local offset, `2020-01-01T10:00:00` is written back as `2020-01-01T08:00:00`. A local time near midnight changes its date. The encoder should format v directly without converting to UTC.
